_note: What a kennelled creature stands on, and who it stands well beside. A silhouette is per **art family** — there are twenty and a creature is drawn from one — and a pair is per **diet**, which is one of the eight buckets the seeds and the retort already use. That is where the C(8,2) is: twenty-eight pairs a lint can count, where families would be a hundred and ninety nobody could author.

silhouettes.name: Wright
silhouettes.blurb: It stands square and it stands where you put it, which is more than most of them do.

silhouettes.name: The Crimper
silhouettes.blurb: Long, low, and it goes through a gap you would have said was shut.

silhouettes.name: Behemoth
silhouettes.blurb: It takes the middle of the run and everything else arranges itself round that.

silhouettes.name: Vermin
silhouettes.blurb: Two cells and it is never in both of them when you look.

silhouettes.name: A Rat
silhouettes.blurb: Small, and it has decided the arrangement is its business now.

silhouettes.name: Bengulon Toad
silhouettes.blurb: It sits in the corner it chose and the corner is damp by morning.

silhouettes.name: Hound
silhouettes.blurb: Head down, tail out, and it will not lie any other way.

silhouettes.name: Sentinel
silhouettes.blurb: Upright, and it has not moved since you put it there. It has not moved.

silhouettes.name: Unwritten
silhouettes.blurb: A post with nothing cut into it, standing where a post would stand.

silhouettes.name: Ash
silhouettes.blurb: What is left, arranged the way what is left arranges itself.

silhouettes.name: Rime
silhouettes.blurb: It comes with its own weather and the run is colder at that end.

silhouettes.name: Clergy
silhouettes.blurb: It kneels, and the shape it makes kneeling is the shape it makes.

silhouettes.name: Idol
silhouettes.blurb: Somebody carried this a long way to put it down exactly here.

silhouettes.name: Crown
silhouettes.blurb: Wide at the top and it insists on the wide part being seen.

silhouettes.name: Drowned
silhouettes.blurb: It leans, and what it leans toward is wherever the water was.

silhouettes.name: Francis
silhouettes.blurb: Six cells of it and no two people describe the same six.

silhouettes.name: Wisp
silhouettes.blurb: One cell. It is not always the same cell and you have stopped checking.

silhouettes.name: Mirror
silhouettes.blurb: It takes a square and gives you back a square, and the square is wrong.

silhouettes.name: Bone
silhouettes.blurb: Upright with a crosspiece, which is the shape of the thing it used to be.

silhouettes.name: Court
silhouettes.blurb: It arrives as one and stands as several, and the run is full afterwards.
